d:
Watch Adiyae Ivalaey from Romeo Juliet is a different kind of a sad love number sung by Anthony Daasan. He sings about heartbreak in a unique tune set by D.Imman in Karky's lyrics.
Song Name - Adiyae Ivalaey
Movie - Romeo Juliet
Singer - Anthony Daasan
Music - D. Imman
Lyrics - Karky
Director - Lakshman
Starring - Jayam Ravi, Hansika Motwani
